name: smwgraphics-k-on-ui-hirasawa
title: K-On! - Ui Hirasawa
description:
Submitted during Summer C3 2025!

It's Yui's younger sister Ui Hirasawa from the hit anime K-On!, now in Super Mario World style! Includes all of the poses included in the game, even the ending sprites! Pair it with her sister Yui (Available separately!) so she can tag along during adventures! Now that's ONE pair of a journey!

Credit goes to Eggroll27 for making the graphics (You can check out the spritesheet here!) and ported by yours truly for ROM hacking usage.
